reason: Exactness proof strategy read in full: PBW gives U(g) = U(n^-) tensor U(b) (thm-pbw-ordered-monomial-basis-for-the-enveloping-algebra), so B_k = U(n^-) tensor Lambda^k(n^-) and the differential is the Chevalley-Eilenberg differential of n^- with coefficients in the free module U(n^-); filtering by PBW degree turns the associated graded into the Koszul complex of S(n^-) on a basis of n^- (regular sequence), which is acyclic in positive degrees (prop-associated-graded-of-the-pbw-filtration-is-commutative, def-pbw-filtration-by-tensor-degree-on-the-enveloping-algebra); exactness descends by the filtered comparison thm-a-complex-is-exact-at-n-exactly-when-its-nth-homology-is-zero. Sources: van Ekeren Sec. 29 pp. 122-123 (split case), Zhou Theorem 9.1 p. 29. All deps examined and published.
